steps.what: Supervise fitness and wellness specialists through observation, coaching and issue resolution

tasks.design: Keep observation, feedback and judgement with the coordinator. Existing {DOCS} support notes without converting attendance or service data into automatic staff evaluations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision depends on context and professional relationships.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing notes support continuity between conversations.
tasks.still_hard: Recognize coaching needs and resolve sensitive concerns.
tasks.human_edge: Observe practice and give useful feedback.
tasks.altitude: Own specialist capability and service quality.

evidence.claim: Direct supervision and coaching retain full time in this design.

assumptions: No repetitive roster or record workload is invented inside staff supervision.
Existing document tools suffice; no new system or upkeep is proposed.
research_questions: Which observed supervision activities are repetitive administration rather than feedback or judgement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Observation, coaching and resolution remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture attendance, participation and defined performance observations for each wellness event
Track captured event entries and calculate specified participation totals
Reconcile participation records and resolve missing or contradictory event data

tasks.design: Configure one event register within the existing booking {OPS_SYSTEM}, with native totals and completeness checks. The coordinator captures observations once and reconciles gaps; the register makes no health assessment or staff-performance inference.
tasks.previous_blocker: Attendance lists and spreadsheets may duplicate the same event entries.
tasks.enabler_now: A structured event record can generate defined totals without repeated transcription.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguish attendance, active participation and genuinely measured outcomes.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve ambiguous entries and understand what the measures represent.

ambition.what: Review consistent event totals more often without collecting additional personal health measures by default.

tasks.altitude: Own useful and proportionate participation records.

evidence.claim: Native forms and defined totals can avoid duplicate event record entry; the proposed implementation and time effect are unmeasured.

assumptions: The coordinator produces event ID, date, permitted participant token, attendance status, participation category and any authorized measured value with units in s1; all observation and capture time is counted in its 40 hours.
Missing status or undefined performance measures remain missing and return to s3; registration alone never becomes an attendance or health-outcome flag.
No collection work is transferred to instructors or participants without counting it; this design keeps capture with the coordinator.
Use the native booking register before a separate application.
Seven focal hours and two other-role hours per 100 baseline hours cover definitions, reconciliation support and access upkeep.
unknowns: Permitted participant identifiers and measure scope
research_questions: Do single-entry event records reduce effort after capture, corrections and upkeep are counted?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=65; gross 35 minus 7 focal upkeep gives net 28% if the assumed duplicate transcription and totaling share exists. Already single-entry records or extensive correction yield zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Conduct or facilitate staff training sessions with practice, questions and feedback

tasks.design: Retain practical training delivery and facilitation with the coordinator. Existing material in {DOCS} supports the session without assuming that slide production replaces staff practice or discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Learning depends on demonstration and feedback.
tasks.enabler_now: Reusable training materials support live delivery.
tasks.still_hard: Check understanding and adapt to specialist experience.

evidence.claim: Staff training delivery and facilitation remain human work in this design.

assumptions: This task covers conducting sessions rather than an invented high-volume material-production process.
Use existing documents; no new automation or maintenance is introduced.
unknowns: Training format and practical assessment needs
research_questions: Is any recurring preparation workload distinct from required live instruction?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Facilitation and practice retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define budget assumptions and validate operating, purchasing and maintenance planning inputs
Calculate budgets and defined scenarios from the validated planning assumptions
Choose budget priorities and implement authorized operational, purchasing and maintenance plans

tasks.design: Configure recurring arithmetic and scenarios in {SPREADSHEET}; keep priorities and implementation decisions with the coordinator. {DOCS} holds the rationale and existing authorization records, without automatic purchases or funding commitments.
tasks.previous_blocker: Changing assumptions may require repeated manual calculation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing spreadsheet functions can repeat explicit scenario arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Balance service quality, resources and maintenance priorities.
tasks.human_edge: Choose realistic priorities and obtain implementation agreement.

ambition.what: Revisit scenarios when validated cost or demand assumptions change.

tasks.altitude: Own transparent planning assumptions and trade-offs.

evidence.claim: A configured workbook can repeat defined budget arithmetic, but cannot choose strategic or maintenance priorities.

assumptions: The coordinator produces line item, period, quantity, unit cost, source, currency, scenario driver and constraint in s1; its 35 hours includes extraction, consultation and validation.
Finance and supplier estimates are obtained through the current process; additional reconciliation support is separately budgeted.
Missing or inconsistent cost inputs stop the affected scenario and return to manual review.
Use existing workbook facilities before building a planning app.
Six extra focal hours and two other-role hours per 100 baseline hours cover formula checks and changed-source support.
Implementation remains within existing authority; the workbook neither buys items nor approves spending.
unknowns: Frequency and complexity of scenario changes
research_questions: Does repeat calculation occupy enough observed planning time to cover input and formula upkeep?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross 20 minus 6 focal upkeep gives net 14% where repeated arithmetic is manual. Existing automatic calculations or heavy input repair yield zero; strategic judgement remains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Own program quality, specialist development and useful participation evidence.
reach: Support program analysts with clean participation records
Prepare budget scenarios for finance partners
role.ambitious_version: A wellness coordinator who records event facts once and repeats budget calculations while retaining direct staff leadership, training and program priorities.
